api:
<HoneyComb data={servers} name={|s: &Server| s.name.as_ref()} value={|s: &Server| s.cpu} thresholds={steps} unit="%" />
PropTypeDefault
dataone row per cellrequired
name, valueFn(&T) -> &str, Fn(&T) -> f64required
thresholdsThresholdsgood below 80, bad above
min, maxf64: the range for percentage thresholds0., 100.
decimalsusizeas many as needed
unittext after the valuenone
columnsusize: cells per rowthe count that gives the largest cells

Hexagons in offset rows, coloured by threshold, with the value and name inside when they fit. Missing values are greyed out.

examples.title: Server load
examples.description: One hexagon per server, coloured by threshold; the grid fills the space.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn servers() {
    let data = use_signal(items("web", 24, 1, 100.));
    rsx! { <HoneyComb data={data} name={|i: &Item| i.label.as_ref()} value={|i: &Item| i.value} thresholds={steps()} unit="%" class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: Default thresholds
examples.description: Without thresholds, good below 80 and bad above.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn default_thresholds() {
    let data = use_signal(items("db", 12, 2, 100.));
    rsx! { <HoneyComb data={data} name={|i: &Item| i.label.as_ref()} value={|i: &Item| i.value} class="h-72" /> }

examples.title: Percentage thresholds
examples.description: Steps at 50% and 90% of a 2 000 GB range.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn percentage() {
    let data = use_signal(items("disk", 16, 3, 2000.));
    rsx! { <HoneyComb data={data} name={|i: &Item| i.label.as_ref()} value={|i: &Item| i.value} thresholds={Thresholds::percentage(vec![(f64::NEG_INFINITY, rgb(0x1e66f5)), (50., rgb(0x8839ef)), (90., rgb(0xd20f39))])} max={2000.} unit=" GB" class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: Two decimals
examples.code:
#[component]
fn decimals() {
    let data = use_signal(
        items("node", 10, 4, 400.)
            .into_iter()
            .map(|item| Item {
                value: item.value / 100.,
                ..item
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    );
    rsx! { <HoneyComb data={data} name={|i: &Item| i.label.as_ref()} value={|i: &Item| i.value} decimals={2} thresholds={Thresholds::absolute(vec![(f64::NEG_INFINITY, rgb(0x40a02b)), (2., rgb(0xd20f39))])} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: Missing values
examples.description: Cells with no value are greyed out.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn missing() {
    let data = use_signal(
        items("host", 14, 8, 100.)
            .into_iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(index, item)| Item {
                value: if index % 5 == 2 { f64::NAN } else { item.value },
                ..item
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    );
    rsx! { <HoneyComb data={data} name={|i: &Item| i.label.as_ref()} value={|i: &Item| i.value} thresholds={steps()} unit="%" class="h-72" /> }
}
